page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.9 GHz, configured with 6 physical cores and 12 vCPUs via hyperthreading. The instance is equipped with 48 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance consistently in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor achieves a single-core stress-ng score of 1862.99 and a multi-core score of 11645.18. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported by hardware flags such as AVX-512 and AES, yielding a PassMark CPU encryption score of 10960.78. Memory performance is characterized by a cached read bandwidth of 629.81 GB/sec, which drops to 83.06 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads.

The instance demonstrates a clear performance tradeoff when handling larger computational models. While LLM inference for a small 135M parameter model processes prompts at 1071.79 tokens/sec, prompt processing for a medium 7B model drops to a weak tier of 24.26 tokens/sec. Given the 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the absence of local storage, this instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, software compilation, and database operations that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.3xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, offering 12 vCPUs across 6 physical cores, alongside 48 GB of RAM. The instance lacks local storage and GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Benchmark data indicates average performance across standard compute, memory, and cryptographic tasks, with a PassMark CPU score of 16425.3 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 11645.18. While it handles small-scale language model inference and software compilation efficiently, performance drops significantly on larger models, with 7B parameter prompt processing falling into the weak tier. This instance is suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, and database operations.
